sources.snippet: The VAD (Vectorized Autonomous Driving) data pipeline is responsible for transforming raw sensor data and map metadata into a structured format suitable for end-to-end perception and planning. The system emphasizes temporal consistency through a queue mechanism and handles the vectorization of map elements into instance-based representations.
